title: Breath Count Three (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Breath count three breath count three
In for three out for three you see
Breath count three breath count three
Calm the storm before the key

[Verse 1]
Before the serve breath count three
In through the nose for one two three
Out through the mouth for one two three
Reset the heart rate calm and free
Vamos vamos respira despacio
Breath count three slow the gracio
Oxygen to the lungs and brain
Clears the mind reduces the strain

[Pre-Chorus]
Breath in three breath out three
Count and ground and let it be
Breath in three breath out three
Reset the heart key

[Chorus]
Breath count three between the points
Breath count three the body anoints
Breath count three calm the rate
Breath count three steady gate
Vamos vamos pa lante
Breath count three
Vamos vamos pa lante
Focus key

[Verse 2]
Before the return breath count three
Lowers the heart by ten or fifteen
Unclenches the jaw and the brow
Ready to receive the ball now
Uno dos tres in then out
Breath count three is the route
Works before serve before return
Before every point the lesson learned

[Bridge]
Common error rushing the serve
Thats how the nerves take the curve
Two seconds three to slow it all down
Breath count three for the crown

[Chorus]
Breath count three between the points
Breath count three the body anoints
Breath count three calm the rate
Breath count three steady gate

[Outro]
Breath count three breath count three
In for three out for three you see
Breath count three breath count three
Calm the storm before the key
